integrity: An exact algebraic proof is accompanied by finite exact-rational coefficient checks and separate Monte Carlo cross-checks, neither of which constitutes independent audit.
limitations: Statement concerns the Lebesgue-stationary center-coordinate covariance, not general Hölder mixing rates. Earlier work already proves the critical inverse-three-halves power exponent, but does not supply the coefficient-level law or off-neutral spectral thresholds. Equivalent unindexed resolvent derivations remain an originality risk.
title: Two spectral-edge transitions in stationary correlations of generalized heterochaos baker maps
